staff_attendance_time_order.name: staff_attendance_time_order
staff_attendance_time_order.value: (check_out_at IS NULL) OR (check_in_at IS NULL) OR (check_out_at >= check_in_at)

staff_credentials_date_order.name: staff_credentials_date_order
staff_credentials_date_order.value: (expires_at IS NULL) OR (issued_at IS NULL) OR (expires_at >= issued_at)

staff_leave_requests_review_consistency.name: staff_leave_requests_review_consistency
staff_leave_requests_review_consistency.value: ((status = ANY (ARRAY['approved'::staff_leave_request_status, 'rejected'::staff_leave_request_status])) AND (reviewed_at IS NOT NULL)) OR (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::staff_leave_request_status, 'cancelled'::staff_leave_request_status]))

staff_profiles_employment_dates.name: staff_profiles_employment_dates
staff_profiles_employment_dates.value: (ended_at IS NULL) OR (hired_at IS NULL) OR (ended_at >= hired_at)

user_data_export_jobs_completion_consist.name: user_data_export_jobs_completion_consistency
user_data_export_jobs_completion_consist.value: ((status = 'completed'::data_export_status) AND (completed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (file_id IS NOT NULL)) OR (status <> 'completed'::data_export_status)
